title: To Each Their Duty
description: Even though rocks are falling from the skies, some Knights of Favonius are still attending to their duties outside the city. Huffman is rather worried about these knights...

dialogs.text: *sigh* It seems that we don't have any good options...
Something the matter?
Ah, it's you. Well... I'm sure you've seen those falling meteorites.
While the city itself has been very fortunate to have avoided any meteorite hits, it's chaos outside.
Between the people who fled into the city to seek shelter and those who fell unconscious without warning, we've got our hands full here.
I'd like to recall all the knights who are currently attending to duties outside so we can settle matters within these four walls first.
But they are currently dispersed out in the wild, and we haven't the extra numbers to go out and look for them.
Could you lend me a hand and let them have a look at these Orders?
I'll get it to them.
Thank you.
I still have matters to attend to.
Alright. I'll find someone else... or think of another way.
It's fortunate that none of the meteorites struck the city...
Hello. Do you require anything?
Here's some Orders for you...
Orders? Oh my. Let me have a look... Instructions to return to the city and help to settle various matters...
Um, so, I could go back to the city, but those two children simply don't want to do the same.
I have no idea where their parents have gone, and I don't want to forcibly bring them back, so I've been stuck here guarding them.
If I were to head back under these circumstances, I don't know what I'd do if something happened to them.
But I've tried several times to persuade them, and now they won't listen to me at all.
So... could you help me convince them? Maybe they might listen to you instead.
If you can convince them to return to the city, then I too can leave in peace.
I'll give it a shot.
Great, thank you!
Really, those two kids — going out to play at a time like this...
Hmm? Is something wrong?
Well, here's the situation...
Oh, I know about the meteorites. But... we haven't seen what they look like when they're coming down.
Will said he knew a good spot to watch them, so we came here.
You can see them from the city too...
But we'd need to go somewhere really high up to see them if we were in the city.
The guards aren't going to let us to get up that high for sure...
That nice man over there is willing to help.
Eh? You mean that weird old guy there? But the last time he came to talk to us, he looked really nasty.
He just wanted us to go back. Didn't say anything else at all...
But if he agrees to take us to a really high place to watch the meteorites, I think... I think we can go back.
But you'd best talk to Will. It was his idea, after all.
That man is really weird. He follows us everywhere, and he sounds so fierce, too...
Hmm? Hello, is something up?
Well, here's the situation...
I know, that's why we came out here — to see the meteorites. Don't worry, we'll go back once we've seen them.
You can see them from the city too...
But then we'd need to get way up high. I tried lots of times, but the guards kept yelling at me to come down. I got a scolding from them afterwards.
That's why I brought Jill over here.
That nice guard over there will help us out.
Help us? Do you mean he can take us to a high point in the city to watch the meteorites?
That can't be... He looks so weird, and angry, too...
I have his Orders with me.
Really? Let me see them! Wow... these really are the official Orders of the Knights!
With this, that man will take us up to see the meteorites, won't he?
Hehe... Watching the meteorites from inside the city would be the best!
Well, you go have a word with him. I'll talk to Jill.
Ah, I really can't wait... I wanna see the meteorites falling.
I wonder what meteorites falling from the sky are gonna look like...
How did it go? Did you manage to convince them?
Well, so it would seem...
Really? That's great! Thank you so much— actually, wait... What do you mean "so it would seem"?
You just need to do your part...
My part? What does that mean...
Eh? You want me to take them to the highest point in Mondstadt and watch the meteors fall? That's... rather dangerous.
Not to mention that they're kids, too. I'll have to report this to Headquarters first...
I've got your Orders right here, you know.
That's... not how you use it, I don't think.
Well, never mind. As long as we can get those kids back to the city, I'll... I'll figure something out.
Really?
Of course, I swear it on my honor as a knight and... as an adult.
No matter who it is, our word is as good as our bond.
Thanks for your help. Leave the rest to me — I'll bring them back to the city shortly.
Afterwards, I'll figure out how to get them to Mondstadt's highest point...
Hmm... Where would the highest point in Mondstadt be?
Hello. Do you need help with anything?
Have a look at these Orders...
Orders? Allow me... So, instructions to return to the city, huh?
My apologies, but I will have to execute these duties later, as I still have important matters to attend to.
It seems as if the monsters around these parts have been affected by the meteorites. They've become much more violent, and are exceptionally dangerous.
I have to clean them out in order to ensure this area's safety.
But there's no one here, is there?
Well, it's precisely because no one's around that I'm free to fight these monsters.
This is a very important matter. I cannot leave while it remains undone.
I'll help.
Great, thank you. There's not one, but a few concentrations of monsters in this area.
Let's split up and destroy all the monsters in our respective areas, and we'll link up here once we're done.
Let's do this together.
Oh, I'll be heading out soon. You go first. Once we've both completed our work, we'll meet back here.
Those monsters were really hard to handle...
I've settled matters on my end. How goes it on yours?
We're done here as well.
Haha, you've got fine moves, don't you? Thanks so much for your help. I don't think those monsters will return to these parts for a while.
Still, I can't return just yet. Other than these monsters, there are still more roaming about in the Stormbearer Mountains.
I want to continue gathering intelligence here — and if someone were to come to harm nearby, I would be on hand to rescue them.
Not everyone is aware of the call to seek shelter, after all.
Alright, then. Please convey my intent to Mr. Huffman. I'm sure he'll understand.
So, how has it gone? Have they all seen the Orders?
They did, but...
"But"? Did something happen?
That man is really weird. He follows us everywhere, and he sounds so fierce, too...
I wonder what meteorites falling from the sky are gonna look like...
Hmm... Where would the highest point in Mondstadt be?
We have to be on our guard against those monsters...
So, about Mack...
Oh, he needs to take the kids to the highest point in Mondstadt to watch the meteorites? Haha, that's fine. That's fine.
As long as they come back safely, Mack just needs to report what happens to me.
Mack's never been good with children. This must have been quite the ride for him.
As for Harry...
Harry... still wants to stand guard in the Stormbearer Mountains?
Hmmm, well, that's fine. If anything were to suddenly occur there, he should be able to report back quickly.
But he can be a bit impulsive. I hope that he can settle this with no mess.
As for Harry...
Harry... still wants to stand guard in the Stormbearer Mountains?
Hmmm, well, that's fine. If anything were to suddenly occur there, he should be able to report back quickly.
But he can be a bit impulsive. I hope that he can settle this with no mess.
So, about Mack...
Oh, he needs to take the kids to the highest point in Mondstadt to watch the meteorites? Haha, that's fine. That's fine.
As long as they come back safely, Mack just needs to report what happens to me.
Mack's never been good with children. This must have been quite the ride for him.
Ah, right, I've made you run about quite a bit, and in these conditions, too. I must thank you properly.
Here, take these as thanks. If you haven't any other urgent matters, please stay within the city limits.
